total.description: How many branches the frozen manifest admitted.

completed.description: How many branches completed every stage.

failed.description: How many branches failed a stage.

items.description: One item per branch, ordered by key.

key.description: The branch identity: the item's unique key.

handoff.description: The handoff of the branch's last stage, or null when the branch failed.

step_id.description: The attempt that wrote the handoff.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the handoff content.

status.description: full when the manifest holds a required target and the survey reached every one, empty when the manifest held no targets, and partial otherwise.

required.description: The required targets: the exact numerator and denominator, and the keys that the survey did and did not reach, ordered by key.

numerator.description: How many required targets the survey reached.

denominator.description: How many required targets the manifest holds.

surveyed.description: The keys of the required targets that the survey reached.

unsurveyed.description: The keys of the required targets that the survey did not reach.

supporting.description: The supporting targets: the exact numerator and denominator, and the keys that the survey did and did not reach, ordered by key.

numerator.description: How many supporting targets the survey reached.

denominator.description: How many supporting targets the manifest holds.

surveyed.description: The keys of the supporting targets that the survey reached.

unsurveyed.description: The keys of the supporting targets that the survey did not reach.

inaccessible.description: The keys of the targets whose report states inaccessible, ordered by key.

excluded.description: The keys of the targets that the source excluded or whose report states excluded, ordered by key.

failed.description: The keys of the targets whose branch failed or reported no outcome, ordered by key.

items.description: One item per branch, ordered by key, with a reference to its report.

key.description: The branch identity: the item's unique key.

outcome.description: What the report states, or null when the branch failed or stated no outcome.

handoff.description: The handoff of the branch's last stage, or null when the branch failed.

step_id.description: The attempt that wrote the handoff.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the handoff content.

kept.description: The first item per "id" that no earlier round of the loop kept or dropped, in branch-key order and then list order, each with the key of its branch.

branch.description: The key of the branch that reported the item.

dropped.description: Every entry that the join did not keep, in fold order, each with the reason.

key.description: The key of the entry, or null when the item states none.

branch.description: The key of the branch that reported the item.

reason.description: Why the join dropped the entry.

failed.description: The keys of the branches that failed or did not settle, ordered by key. They reported no entries.

passed.description: The verdicts that reached the quorum. One verdict per value of "area", ordered by that value.

group.description: The value of "area" that the verdict counts.

abstain.description: How many branches abstained, failed, or did not settle.

reason.description: The counts against the thresholds that decided the verdict.

rejected.description: The verdicts that did not reach the quorum. One verdict per value of "area", ordered by that value.

group.description: The value of "area" that the verdict counts.

abstain.description: How many branches abstained, failed, or did not settle.

reason.description: The counts against the thresholds that decided the verdict.

failed.description: The keys of the branches that failed or did not settle, ordered by key. Each abstained.
